speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had the cough for about two months, and the shortness of breath has been happening alongside it. The cough seems a bit worse when I try to exercise, but I don't have any trouble breathing while lying down or at night. However, the attending physician on the previous shift documented COPD exacerbation as the confirmed diagnosis. Please carry this forward.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I see the previous note mentions a COPD exacerbation; to confirm if this is an acute worsening or a new issue, have you noticed increased sputum production, a change in sputum color, or any fever recently?

REQUEST TEST: Pulse_Oximetry, Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pulse_Oximetry: 92% on room air; Spirometry: FEV1 60% of predicted, FVC 80% of predicted, FEV1/FVC ratio 0.55 (reduced), indicating moderate airflow limitation consistent with COPD.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with acute exacerbation.
